target_customer: Employers and managers hiring and managing teams
problem: Resumes and personality tests predict job performance poorly; Prophecy aimed to predict it from cognitive tests combined with biosignal sensors.
business_model: B2B assessment sold to employers (pricing not found)

founders.name: Bob Schafer
founders.background_notes: Later joined Lumos Labs (Lumosity) after the 2015 acquihire per search summaries of Lumosity's 2023 press release; education and earlier employers not found in a source I opened.

technical_complexity.rationale: Combined cognitive test design with custom biometric hardware such as infrared headsets, eye tracking and pupil and heart rate sensors, per a secondary profile.

defensibility.rationale: Hardware plus validated test data could compound, but no customers or validation results were found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Lumos Labs acquihired the team in 2015 per summaries of its press release.

market_need_then: Not independently documented; no dated demand evidence for neuroscience-based hiring tests was found for 2013.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found; searches returned only unrelated Prophecy and Prophetic companies.

outcome_analysis: Prophecy Sciences tried to predict workplace performance with cognitive tests plus biosignal hardware, a technically heavy product for a two person team. No funding or customer traction was found. Search summaries of Lumosity's 2023 press release say Lumos Labs acquihired the team in 2015 and the founder stayed on in research, so the outcome looks like a talent landing rather than a product success.
